instruction: Transform the h:mm time in D3 into total minutes and input the final value into cell G3.

metadata.explanation: Task requires converting total hours (7:40) to total minutes. Verified with Python: 2:25 = 145 min, 1:30 = 90 min, 0:45 = 45 min, 1:10 = 70 min, 1:50 = 110 min. Total = 145+90+45+70+110 = 460 minutes. Alternatively, 7:40 = 7*60 + 40 = 460 minutes. Evaluator uses custom getter to read cell G3 value and custom metric to compare with expected value 460.
